title.en: HR Surging Fast on the First Ramp

tip.en: Only 3 minutes in and you're already at 11% grade with HR climbing from 107 to 119 in the next 30 seconds. Compared to yesterday's opener (avg HR 125 for the whole run), you're burning matches early — ease the effort now to protect the second half.
tip.zh: 仅跑了约3分钟，坡度已达11%，心率在随后30秒内从107跃升至119。与昨天全程均心率125相比，你在前段就消耗了大量体力，建议此处主动降速，为后半程留余量。

tip.en: Grade has been above 15% for 75 seconds and HR has been locked at 150 bpm for over a minute. This is your highest sustained cardiac load of the run. On a 4km morning run this intensity spike is disproportionate — shorten your stride to nearly a shuffle to avoid blowing up before the summit.
tip.zh: 坡度已连续75秒超过15%，心率在150附近持续超过1分钟。这是本次跑步中心脏负荷最高的持续阶段。对于一次4公里的晨跑而言，这种强度过高——建议缩短步幅至小碎步，避免在到达坡顶前耗尽体能。

title.en: 157 bpm on Flat Ground — Cardiac Lag at the Top

tip.en: The gradient has dropped to zero but HR has just peaked at 157 — your highest of the run and matching your recent history max. This is classic cardiac lag after a savage climb; the body hasn't caught up yet. This is the moment to actively walk 15–20 seconds before the descent to avoid a stumble while the heart is still racing.
tip.zh: 坡度已降至零，但心率刚刚达到峰值157——这是本次跑步的最高值，也与近期历史最高心率持平。这是剧烈爬坡后典型的心率滞后现象。此时应主动步行15–20秒，待心率回落后再开始下坡，以避免在心跳剧烈时失去控制。

tip.en: You're dropping at -17% grade with HR still at 150 — well above the 130 average for this run. High HR on steep downhill means quads are braking hard and balance is compromised; lean back slightly and shorten contact time to protect the knees.
tip.zh: 当前以-17%坡度下坡，心率仍维持在150——远高于本次跑步均值130。在陡峭下坡中心率偏高，意味着股四头肌正在大力制动，平衡感下降；建议身体微微后倾，缩短触地时间，保护膝关节。

title.zh: 中途停顿——主动策略还是被迫为之？

tip.en: HR drops sharply from 147 to 124 over about 30 seconds with pace going to null — a clear stop. Given that the avg HR across your last 8 runs is 135 and you just hit 157, this rest was probably necessary. The fact that HR recovers to 119 within 20 seconds shows reasonable fitness; next time try to anticipate this by hiking the steepest section rather than running it to exhaustion.
tip.zh: 心率在约30秒内从147骤降至124，配速数据消失，明显出现停顿。考虑到近8次跑步均心率135，而你刚刚触及157，这次休息很可能是必要的。心率在20秒内恢复至119，说明有氧基础尚可；下次可在最陡段提前改为快走，避免跑至力竭后被迫停下。

title.en: Descent Unlocked — Best Pacing of the Run
title.zh: 下坡释放——全程配速最佳段

tip.en: HR has settled to 137 and pace is now around 4:15 on a -9% grade — the most efficient movement of the entire run. This is what controlled descent looks like: cardiac load proportionate to effort, cadence presumably quick. File this feeling away as the template for how you want to handle downhills throughout.
tip.zh: 心率已稳定在137，配速在-9%坡度上达到4:15左右——这是全程效率最高的跑动阶段。这就是受控下坡的理想状态：心脏负荷与体力输出匹配，步频相对快速。把这种感觉记住，作为今后处理下坡段的参照模板。

title.en: Late 25% Climb Walked at Low HR — Hidden Fatigue
title.zh: 末段25%陡坡低心率步行——隐性疲劳信号

tip.en: With only 300m left you hit the steepest grade of the entire run (25%+) yet HR stays between 108–126 — far below the 150+ you reached at the same kind of terrain earlier. This isn't fitness; it's accumulated muscular fatigue suppressing output. On future runs, budget something for this final climb rather than arriving here on empty legs.
tip.zh: 距终点仅剩约300米，却遭遇全程最陡坡（25%以上），但心率仅维持在108–126之间——远低于前段同等地形时的150+。这并非体能进步，而是肌肉累积疲劳导致输出受限的信号。在之后的训练中，应为这段末尾爬坡预留体能，而非带着空腿抵达此处。
